name: React Image Editor
summary: React component wrapping the Unlayer Image Editor: crop, resize, filters, draw, text, shapes, stickers and frames.
description: A React wrapper around the Unlayer Image Editor for React 18+, shipped with the 'use client' directive so it works in React Server Components environments. Tools cover crop, resize, rotate and flip, filters, freehand draw, text, shapes, stickers and frames, with an optional AI Assistant that can be enabled. Props configure the built-in tools, locale and callbacks; an editor instance is exposed through a ref, and the README covers prop updates, error handling and localization.
contains: crop, resize, rotate, flip, filters, draw, text, shapes, stickers and frames tools
React 18+; ships with 'use client' and works in React Server Components
editor instance exposed via ref; prop changes documented
